3042e2dbd28723fe6ea76b7032c26358893758cc.summary: SentinelOne reports that the DPRK-aligned TraderTraitor group used fake job-interview coding projects with weaponized Terraform lock files to deliver the macOS backdoors FLATROOF and ROOFDECK. The backdoors were found on a second victim, a small India-based IT services provider, after first being seen in the 2026 LayerZero Labs attack. The report says that attack led to a USD 292 million theft from KelpDAO. The report says the second intrusion appears to have yielded little value to the attackers.

hedges: The report says the victim yielded insufficient value to sustain the intrusion, which it believes is why the intrusion stayed small.
It is unclear if the companies named in the lures were fabricated by the threat actor, or if the actor was posing as hiring teams from real companies.
The report says it cannot prove how the backdoors were delivered, since they were on disk before any observed activity.
The report says the FLATROOF backdoor is likely intended for initial data collection and to deploy secondary payloads.
The report says it can only speculate whether the later stripped ROOFDECK version was a reaction to the LayerZero Labs publication.
The report says the stripped ROOFDECK version was likely intended to more effectively evade detection.
